description: Replacement of garage door with windows and conversion to a habitable room
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Unnumbered Location Plan; 2/5 - Existing Block Plan; 3/5 - Existing Floor Plans; 4/5 - Proposed Floor Plan and Elevations; 5/5 - Existing Elevations; Unnumbered Supporting Statement. Received: 03/10/2020/ ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The converted garage hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 18 Firs Drive, Hounslow, TW5 9TD
